hypothesis: Every native campaign mark equals the self-financing receipt ledger at knownAt plus remaining shares valued at that exact publicly received bar close; the independent P9C risk clock must agree at all comparable events if receipts match.
refutation: Any native campaign mark differs from independently reconstructed realized+inventory value
Any P9C observed equity, cash or peak differs from native under identical native receipts
Admitted identities and quantities diverge in a supposedly identical native control
A delayed IOC is wrongly certified as equivalent to instant native receipt
Any missing bar, future-known receipt, negative inventory or unfunded action
Any unapproved change of generator, costs, limit or holdout
fixtures: Healthy two-asset full native funded campaigns
Partial target exits with original quantity conservation
Modeled IOC no-fill with no invented proceeds
Deliberately delayed IOC receipt must invalidate native equivalence
limitations: Engineering fixtures, not sampled M9 worlds
Native close and exit prices may still be nonexecutables from OHLC
Partial-entry/reject/outage/impact and virtual cell gates unverified
